verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for an analytics platform with a CLI and SDKs, so the axis applies. The pack documents no telemetry opt-out. The beta opt-in feature and the CLI's ability to skip artifact upload without contacting PostHog are different features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
